ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java var addressList = payload.value default payload
fun normalize(addressString: String) = do { var lowerCaseAddr = lower(addressString default "") var noPunctuation = lowerCaseAddr replace /[^a-z0-9\s]/ with "" var abbreviated = noPunctuation replace /\bsuite\b/ with "ste" replace /\bapartment\b/ with "apt" replace /\bbuilding\b/ with "bldg" replace /\bfloor\b/ with "fl" replace /\broom\b/ with "rm" replace /\bnortheast\b/ with "ne" replace /\bnorthwest\b/ with "nw" replace /\bsoutheast\b/ with "se" replace /\bsouthwest\b/ with "sw" replace /\bnorth\b/ with "n" replace /\bsouth\b/ with "s" replace /\beast\b/ with "e" replace /\bwest\b/ with "w" replace /\bavenue\b/ with "ave" replace /\bstreet\b/ with "st" replace /\bboulevard\b/ with "blvd" replace /\bplace\b/ with "pl" replace /\bhighway\b/ with "hwy" replace /\bcanyon\b/ with "cyn" replace /\bcenter\b/ with "ctr" replace /\bcircle\b/ with "cir" replace /\bdrive\b/ with "dr" replace /\blane\b/ with "ln" replace /\bmountain\b/ with "mtn" replace /\broad\b/ with "rd" replace /\bcourt\b/ with "ct" replace /\bbroadway\b/ with "brdway" replace /\bparkway\b/ with "pkwy" replace /\bturnpike\b/ with "tpke" replace /\bmeadow\b/ with "mdw"
--- abbreviated replace /\s/ with "" }
var matchedRecords = addressList filter ((address) -> (address.OnHoldStatus default "No") == "No" and normalize((address.AddressStreet default "") ++ " " ++ (address.AddressZipCode default "")) == vars.normalizedShipping ) --- matchedRecords reduce ((record, acc = {}) -> do { // Map to AddressLocationId (The Primary Address ID) instead of DeliveryAddressLocationId acc ++ { (record.CustomerAccount as String): record.AddressLocationId } })

var tags = (vars.originalPayload.tags default "") ++ (vars.originalPayload.customer.tags default "") var gateway = lower(vars.originalPayload.payment_gateway_names[0] default "")

"DefaultShippingSiteId": "Zyris", "DefaultShippingWarehouseId": "Zyris",
("DeliveryAddressLocationId": vars.locationIdMap[vars.selectedCustomerAccount as String]) if (vars.locationIdMap[vars.selectedCustomerAccount as String] != null),
"ZyrTaxAmount": (vars.originalPayload.total_tax default 0) as Number {class: "java.math.BigDecimal"}, "ZyrFreightAmount": (vars.originalPayload.total_shipping_price_set.shop_money.amount default 0) as Number {class: "java.math.BigDecimal"}, "ZyrShipRatesCalculated": { "muleAdditions": { "kind": "enum", "type": "Microsoft.Dynamics.DataEntities.NoYes" }, "value": "Yes" },
"SalesOrderOriginCode": "SHOPIFY", "ZyrPaymMode": paymentMethod, "PaymentTermsName": paymentTerms }
